description: The Professional Calendar Visual transforms your Power BI reports into a fully interactive project and event calendar. Map your date data to display events as colour-coded bars spanning their full duration across four view modes: Month, Week, Day, and Year. Navigate periods using built-in header controls, highlight today, and distinguish weekends at a glance. Events are automatically grouped and colour-coded by category, holidays are displayed in 8 distinct styles, and the visual participates fully in Power BI's cross-filtering ecosystem — click an event to filter other visuals, or let slicers and tables filter the calendar. All visual elements are configurable through the Format pane with no code required. Designed for project managers, schedulers, and analysts who need to visualize timelines, deadlines, and resource schedules directly within their Power BI dashboards.
